meta.rationale: Fire bias b3[5] +2: Gold random-walks vertically in threat-free states (up 12%, down 12% each step) with no benefit; vertical moves enter rows where approaching enemies are only partially visible. Evidence: two edits that changed movement/waiting both lowered score; this reduces purposeless row changes while keeping dodge, ascent and diver/enemy seeking dominant.
